title: Revenue overview
description: Orders from the example dataset. Every number links to the query that produced it.

filters.label: Region
filters.options_sql: SELECT DISTINCT region FROM orders ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Monthly revenue
panels.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date) AS month, sum(amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE NOT refunded AND ($region IS NULL OR region = $region) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Monthly orders
panels.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date) AS month, count(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE ($region IS NULL OR region = $region) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Refund rate
panels.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date) AS month, avg(refunded::INT) AS refund_rate FROM orders WHERE ($region IS NULL OR region = $region) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Monthly revenue by category
panels.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date) AS month, category, sum(amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE NOT refunded AND ($region IS NULL OR region = $region) AND ($since IS NULL OR order_date >= CAST($since AS DATE)) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Revenue by region
panels.sql: SELECT region, sum(amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE NOT refunded AND ($since IS NULL OR order_date >= CAST($since AS DATE)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Monthly orders by channel
panels.sql: SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', order_date), '%b %Y') AS month, channel, count(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE ($region IS NULL OR region = $region) AND ($since IS NULL OR order_date >= CAST($since AS DATE)) GROUP BY date_trunc('month', order_date), 1, 2 ORDER BY date_trunc('month', order_date), 2

panels.title: Weekly signups by traffic source
panels.sql: SELECT date_trunc('week', date) AS week, source, sum(signups) AS signups FROM traffic WHERE ($since IS NULL OR date_trunc('week', date) >= CAST($since AS DATE)) GROUP BY ALL HAVING count(DISTINCT date) = 7 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Products
panels.sql: SELECT product, category, count(*) AS orders, sum(quantity) AS units, round(sum(amount), 2) AS revenue, round(avg(refunded::INT), 4) AS refund_rate FROM orders WHERE ($region IS NULL OR region = $region) AND ($since IS NULL OR order_date >= CAST($since AS DATE)) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY revenue DESC
